Extend existing C# executable source classification and Python native integration tests, include scheduled physical-presence policy test in existing isolated CI.
acceptance: Authentic Unity managed compile; negative controls trackpad-device bit required, event source mouse mandatory, touchscreen ignored, non-trackpad mouse ignored, old epoch and temporary wrapper safety retained; no device acceptance claim.
